rv.q: Lauder is a pleasantly satisfying introduction to a larger-than-life character who has been sadly forgotten.

In Lauder: Scotland’s Kilted King of Broadway, Jamie MacDougall brings this larger-than-life figure back to the stage with infectious warmth and musical flair that turns biography into jubilant theatrical celebration.

cn.t: MacDougall delivers an infectious, warmly charming portrayal of music hall legend Sir Harry Lauder, embodying the entertainer's larger-than-life personality and stage professionalism with a twinkle in his eye.
